kind: ADDITIVE. One single closed-loop deterministic nominal evaluation of the immutable rev3q candidate. No existing file/artifact/contract is modified
purpose: ELIGIBILITY of S1A as a future source==init for a July-style anchor-collection stage. NOT a deployable promotion

status_flags.promotion_requires: closed-loop nominal rollout under a separate token

candidate_under_test.immutability: READ-ONLY: the candidate's module, receipt and manifest are digest-verified BEFORE and AFTER the run; the flags are NEVER edited, whatever the outcome

command_shape_note: identical construction to rev3c/e/j: JOB_TIMEOUT_ARGS is the canonical flag set of the chain and contains --step-timeout-s 900 and --startup-timeout-s 900 as prescribed, plus --no-progress, --run-timeout-s 7200 and --stall-timeout-s 1500 already used by every prior rollout of this chain

execution_policy.no_clobber: the job dir must not exist; it is created with exist_ok=False and the log with mode 'x'
execution_policy.action_selection: deterministic mean; NO operational sigma (0.005 remains an unresolved serialisation placeholder)

binding_eligibility_gates.phase_timeout: phase_timeout_stance == 0 AND phase_timeout_swing == 0, counted over ALL rows from reward_terms.phase_timeout_exceeded + phase_timeout_side (1=stance, 2=swing)
binding_eligibility_gates.morphology_causal_contract_failure: rows_positive == 0 AND max == 0 AND failure == false, read PER ROW from reward_terms.morphology_causal_failed_closed, NEVER inferred from end_reason
binding_eligibility_gates.resync_count: max over rows <= 1 AND final <= 1, both recorded
binding_eligibility_gates.penetration: max <= 0.020 m AND no grf_penetration termination
binding_eligibility_gates.meaning: entry gate to the anchor-collection stage ONLY; never a deployable promotion

mandatory_diagnostics_never_relaxable: invalid events (count, per-step type) and valid HS / TO counts
morphology_causal dropped_wait_hs and terminal_flushed (last and max)
knee/ankle q min, max, mean, sign fraction, out-of-bounds steps
RMSE, Pearson correlation, sign agreement and shape statistics vs the prescribed targets on the grid
B3 computed ONLY inside the phase window [0.55, 0.80] via reward_terms.pros_ankle_angle_imitation_target_phase (not_evaluable if the field is zero, NEVER the global minimum)
raw and applied actions, clipping and saturation fractions over the whole trace
comparison with the S0D rollout and with the July homologs where homologous

outcome_policy.on_fail: preserve everything, diagnose the cause, write FAIL receipt + report, STOP. No retry, no tuning, no promotion
outcome_policy.on_pass: write PASS eligibility receipt + report and STOP for Codex audit. Do NOT build the anchors
